options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: credentials_cache_TTL
options.description: Sets the Time-To-Live (in minutes) expiration time in minutes for a Windows entry in the credentials cache.

options.name: host_name
options.description: The name that will be used by NFS clients to connect to this NFS server.

options.name: is_extended_credentials_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether the NFS server supports more than 16 Unix groups in a Unix credential.

options.name: is_nfsv3_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether NFSv3 is enabled on the NAS server.

options.name: is_nfsv4_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether NFSv4 is enabled on the NAS server.

options.name: is_secure_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether secure NFS is enabled on the NFS server.

options.name: is_skip_unjoin
options.description: Allow to bypass NFS server unjoin. If false modification will fail if secure is enabled and current kdc_type is MS Windows. If secure is enabled either unjoin NFS server before deleting or set value to true.

options.name: is_use_smb_config_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether SMB authentication is used to authenticate to the KDC.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: Unique identifier/name of the NAS server to which the network interface belongs, as defined by the I(nas_server) resource type.

options.name: nfs_server_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the NFS server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the NFS server should be enabled or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
